scenes.event: Chloe reunites with her childhood friend Anna and college roommate Bell at a cafe
scenes.location: A cozy, quiet corner of a local café
scenes.description: Chloe sits at a small wooden table, sipping a cup of black coffee. Anna and Bell join her, each choosing a seat carefully. The atmosphere is tense but polite, with the soft hum of background chatter and the aroma of freshly ground beans.

characters.name: Chloe Nelson
characters.description: Chloe is 30 years old, with a quiet demeanor. Her eyes betray a sense of inner turmoil, though she remains composed. She wears a simple, neutral outfit that reflects her introspective nature.; Female, years old, former employee, 30 years old; Occupation: Retail sales; Personality: Introverted, Introspective, Empathetic; Values: Loyalty, Authenticity, Emotional honesty; Interests: Coffee culture, Deep conversation, Self-reflection; Experiences: Long-term stable job, Close friendship, Recent career transition
characters.position: At the table center, facing both Anna and Bell
characters.states: Low spirits, suppressed anger, emotional honesty

characters.name: Anna Carter
characters.description: Anna is talkative and direct, with a tendency to cut to the chase; Female; Age: 29; Occupation: Management consultant; Personality: Analytical, empathetic, assertive; Values: Professional integrity, loyalty, personal growth; Interests: Networking, reading business journals, yoga; Experiences: Successfully led a team through a corporate restructuring, maintained a long-distance friendship with Chloe and Bell during college, recently noticed a shift in Bell's behavior that worries her.

characters.name: Bell Nguyen
characters.description: Bell is more reserved than Anna but visibly uneasy, fidgeting with their phone and glancing at Chloe with a mix of empathy and discomfort; Non-binary; Age: 27; Occupation: Social worker; Personality: Compassionate, introverted, observant; Values: Empathy, authenticity, community support; Interests: Volunteering at animal shelters, indie music, journaling; Experiences: Witnessed a close friend struggle with mental health, worked in crisis intervention during the pandemic, recently ended a long-term relationship due to emotional disconnect.

actions.dialogue: Chloe, I know it's been a while, but I have to ask—why did you quit your job?
It wasn't the right fit anymore. I needed to step back and think about what I really want.
Hey, remember when we used to talk about opening our own little coffee shop back in college?
Yeah... I always loved the idea. It felt like a place where we could be real with each other, you know?

actions.action: Encourages Chloe to open up more
actions.dialogue: You can talk to us, Chloe. We're still here for you. What was it really like at work?
It was... exhausting. I felt like I was just going through the motions. I don't know if I can explain it right now.
You don't have to explain everything now. We're here, and we care. Whatever you're going through, you're not alone.

scenes.plot: Chloe's resignation becomes the focal point of the reunion, prompting Anna to ask directly about it. Bell tries to shift the mood by reminiscing about their shared dream of a coffee shop. Chloe reveals her emotional struggle, and Bell offers reassurance, while Anna continues to push for honesty.
scenes.social_purpose: To explore Chloe's recent career transition and the underlying tensions in the friendship, while highlighting the values of emotional honesty, loyalty, and empathy among the characters.

chunk.text: Chloe's resignation brings the group together, but it also uncovers the distance that has grown between them. Anna's directness, Bell's empathy, and Chloe's introspection form the core of this fragile interaction.
